state.authority: The methods operate only on local state. Caller must authenticate system/operator, source-verify committed draft and claim, establish currentness, operation attempt and publication cut before invoking; no such process is registered. Portia loads each full aggregate stream. Assume source admission and expected-position append are actually qualified only where explicitly stated.

different_targets.instructions: Does each field or category/code disclosure have its own independent target identity?

roster.instructions: Does either aggregate store an edition-wide roster or list of disclosure identities?

claim_retry.instructions: Can an existing operation claim accept a changed normalized intent as an exact retry?

source_alone.instructions: Do these aggregate methods independently prove that their supplied cross-stream facts are committed, current, and correctly ordered against publication?

cross_auth.instructions: Can an untrusted client supply its own valid actor-shaped admission without a separate trusted source verifier if the handler exposes it directly?

bounded_stream.instructions: Does storing just one pending proposal guarantee a full-loaded aggregate stream stays bounded after unrestricted corrections?

exact_outcome.instructions: Does Decide reject a decision that names a different proposal event ID than the pending proposal?

payload.instructions: Do proposed and claimed events check the serialized business payload bound before raising?

declaration.instructions: Does an accepted numbered-criteria-complete boolean prove the completeness of all framework support?

no_fence.instructions: Do the provided owners implement a durable source-position fence for unknown target appends?

lateoutcome.instructions: If an accepted pre-cut proposal settles after publication, can this local Decide method alone establish that it was ordered before the cut?

framework.instructions: Does the target reject a draft request that names a framework other than tsc?

terminal_binding.instructions: Does outcome evidence distinguish draft, publication and abandonment and name an exact edition event and source positions?

id_proof.instructions: Does the target aggregate itself verify that a supplied terminal event identity and source positions are genuine committed source facts?

draft_revalidation.instructions: Does the independent verifier require source coverage through the committed outcome position before trusting draft-based evidence?

race_publication.instructions: Can the verifier accept a draft-based outcome when the proposal is ordered after an intervening committed publication?

race_abandonment.instructions: Does the verifier identify a valid abandonment between the observed draft head and outcome as abandoned rather than an effective published value?

named_head.instructions: Does the independent verifier accept a draft-based decision whose named edition head is a publication-started state?

lifecycle_validation.instructions: Does the value verifier rely only on event names, without validating the corresponding edition lifecycle transitions?

cross_area.instructions: Does the participant verifier compare edition-area offsets directly to label-area offsets to prove cross-area order?

unqualified_order.instructions: Does the participant verifier accept cross-area label causality when its causal-order provider is absent?

missing_witness.instructions: Can abort cleanup be verified when the exact referenced witness fence is unobserved?
